description: Personal AI assistant you run on your own devices. Multi-channel gateway connecting to WhatsApp, Telegram, Slack, Discord, Signal, iMessage, IRC, Microsoft Teams, Matrix, Feishu, LINE, and 15+ more. Skills system, multi-agent routing, Voice Wake, Talk Mode, Live Canvas, browser control. The architecture that spawned the skills-based agent paradigm.
added_reason: Original skills-based gateway architecture - 354k stars, the paradigm that inspired hermes-agent and many others
